Despite this statistical trend, the larger picture shows hope for stability remains, as year-to-date crossings stay near multi-decade lows. This outcome reflects enforcement policies in place, offering a sense of order. Yet, an unresolved challenge persists as lawmakers struggle to agree on separate funding, leaving the path forward unclear for all involved.
